title: Validate fast Undo while Clear-list delegates are retiring
environment: Qt 6.12.0 Windows native D3D11 WARP/offscreen Qt Quick Test and Android API 36 x86_64 isolated emulator-5580; current application after UI-023, UX-005 and UI-017.
finding: Early coverage tests sometimes lost Undo history when tapping before outgoing delegates had retired. This was initially classified too strongly as a confirmed Clear-list bug.
current_evidence: 2026-11-07: Fast and settled Clear/Undo both pass without application changes. Window-coordinate mouse/touch presses on the actually rendered bar reach Undo while delegates still retire; no outgoing row receives a press. Native Android presses at 398-439 ms after Clear restore exact persisted records before the 500 ms removal sequence ends.
reproduction_status: No current application defect reproduced, including the transition-time path. Validation and permanent coverage are complete; user accepted closure on 2026-11-07.
validation_paths: Real drawer Clear, then first enabled/rendered Undo while outgoing delegates remain; assert the transition is active at press time.
Capture the rendered bar and inject through window coordinates; spy Undo request delivery and outgoing-row press signals.
Compare fast and settled controls with 3/30 items and Light/Dark; Windows mouse/touch plus real native Android input and frames.
expected: The offered, enabled Undo bar restores removed names, ordering, flags and IDs even while outgoing rows are still retiring. Their eventual cleanup must not damage the restored model.
tests: tests/flows/tst_userflows.qml: UserFlows::test_drawer_removal:all_mouse and :all_touch retain full restoration assertions; no XFAIL or skip remains.
tests/android/test_reset.py --case clear verifies real native touch Undo, including saved order/checks/IDs.

tests/fastundo/tst_fastundo.qml, registered as qshopper_fastundo_tests and qshopper_fastundo_rendering_tests: 18 records each, all pass; direct input-receiver and active-retirement assertions plus actual bar pixels and exact restoration.
tests/android/test_fastundo.py with BackGesture clear-undo mode: 8 fast/settled records pass, with actual frames, device-clock press deadlines and exact saved names/order/flags/UUIDs.
history: Earlier flows-stable.txt/undo-final-native.txt failures and expected-failure runs lacked whole-list settlement. They are investigation evidence, superseded as acceptance results by the final readiness-aware runs. The 2026-11-07 native driver initially compared UUID spelling with/without braces; canonical identity comparison corrects that test-only failure. A PNG export delayed its supposedly fast tap to 1817 ms; that run was rejected as timing-invalid. Device-local raw capture with deferred transfer fixes the driver timing, not the app.
implementation_scope: Selected by the user on 2026-11-07 before release planning. No application change is needed or made. Add permanent transition-time validation and record the current passing result; do not label historical driver failures as a confirmed app bug.

resolution.acceptance: User accepted the validation results and requested ticket closure and commit.
resolution.summary: Close the validation gap with permanent fast/settled Clear/Undo coverage. No current application bug was reproduced and no application change was needed.
resolution.verification: 159 Windows records across the four affected/control CTest entries and eight native Android fast/settled records pass. Exact test locations, timing, outcomes and limits are recorded below.
resolution.remaining: None within UI-015. Release planning remains REL-001.

validation.windows: Configured/built with tools/verify-windows.ps1 -Action Build -Jobs 2. Four affected/control CTest entries pass: fastundo, fastundo_rendering, flow and model; 159 records total, zero failures/skips. The unchanged full suite was not repeated for this test-only investigation.
validation.android: 8 records pass on the installed UI-017 APK, using disposable data. Fast presses: Light 3/30 items at 398/415 ms; Dark 3/30 items at 436/439 ms. Device-local actual frames precede each press; transfer/PNG encoding happens afterward. Settled controls also restore exact saved order/checks/UUIDs.
validation.limits: Windows directly observes retiring delegates and input receivers. Android establishes native timing, visible target and persisted outcome without instrumenting application QML; it does not directly inspect delegate lifetime. The under-500-ms deadline is tied to the unchanged production remove transition. No physical-device installation or new APK is required for test-only changes.
validation.conclusion: Current fast Undo works as expected. No app fix or failing-before app regression is claimed; the new tests guard the formerly uncovered trigger.
